name: finsider
description: Financial due diligence worked like software: your agent picks up Finsider Actions, works them with Finsider's verified financial tools and reports live on the Actions board.

interface.longDescription: Finsider runs financial due diligence the way software is built. Every engagement (quality of earnings, net working capital, proof of cash) is a board of Actions, and your agent picks them up like tickets: it reads the Action, works it with Finsider's verified tools for statements, schedules, reconciliations and verification, and its session shows live on the Finsider Actions board until the team reviews the work and moves it to Done. Figures always come from Finsider's own calculations, every change is previewed and needs your approval, and conclusions stay subject to professional review.
defaultPrompt: Work the next open Finsider Action on my company.
